Keep volumetric forms soft, simplified, and pastel. - Limit the palette aggressively for a designed, print-friendly look. - Use {argument name="depth" default="shallow spatial depth"} with subtle diorama hints. - Make the final result feel like an art print, a magazine illustration, and a miniature set all at once. - Graphic limited-palette editorial hybrid. - Printmaking texture fused with soft pastel mini-world staging. -
